logline: 그네 뛰던 처녀와 사또의 아들이 백년가약을 맺지만, 새로 온 사또가 그 약속을 짓밟으려 한다.
destination: 남원 관아의 옥 — 약속을 지킬 수 있는지 시험받는 자리
anchor: a sixteen-year-old Korean girl with a long braided daenggi, crimson chima and green jeogori
palette: spring green and crimson, hanji cream, lantern amber, cold stone grey

beats.beat: 처녀가 버드나무 아래 그네를 힘껏 굴린다.
beats.visual: a girl in crimson skirt on a swing under willow branches, pavilion roof beyond a stream
beats.motion: the swing arcs upward toward the willows, her skirt billows, blossoms shake loose

beats.beat: 누각의 젊은 도령이 그 모습을 바라본다.
beats.visual: a young nobleman in a blue durumagi at a pavilion rail watching across a stream
beats.motion: he leans forward on the rail toward the stream, his sleeve catches the wind, willows sway

beats.beat: 두 사람이 촛불 앞에서 잔을 나눈다.
beats.visual: a young couple facing each other over a low table with two cups, one candle between them
beats.motion: the cups rise toward each other, the candle flame leans, shadows swing on paper doors

beats.visual: a young nobleman mounted on a horse on a hill road, a girl standing small at the roadside
beats.motion: the horse carries him away up the hill road, dust trails back, her hand lifts

beats.beat: 새 사또가 마루에 앉아 처녀를 내려다본다.
beats.visual: a heavyset official seated on a magistrate's platform looking down at a kneeling girl
beats.motion: he leans down toward her from the platform, a fan snaps open, banners flap

beats.beat: 처녀가 옥 안에서 고개를 꼿꼿이 든다.
beats.visual: a girl seated behind thick wooden prison bars, straw on the floor, chin lifted
beats.motion: her chin lifts toward the bars, torchlight crosses her face, straw stirs

beats.beat: 누더기 차림의 사내가 잔칫상 앞에 나선다.
beats.visual: a man in beggar's rags stepping before a lavish official banquet under lanterns
beats.motion: he steps forward into the banquet, guests turn toward him, lanterns swing overhead

beats.visual: an abandoned banquet table with an overturned cup and scattered dishes, lanterns guttering
beats.motion: a lantern swings over the table, the cup rocks and settles, petals drift down

withheld: 누더기 사내가 암행어사가 된 이몽룡이라는 것과 사또가 맞는 최후

beggar_man.label: 누더기 차림의 사내
beggar_man.desc: a Korean man in his twenties, torn hemp rags, battered straw hat, unkempt topknot, bare dusty feet
beggar_man.avoid: 암행어사 신분을 드러내는 마패·관복은 아직 보이지 않는다
